title: People from my past
content: I just discovered this community and see a lot of discussion around what the environment looks like, but am seeking more of your thoughts about what happens within these environments. I find myself having similar situations within these worlds repeat. A few in particular: -I consistently run into exes from previous relationships in these dreams. Some I want to adamantly avoid and others feel more open to interaction. Regardless, it always feels uncomfortable, but one is there- whether it’s at the concert, the wedding, or by the pool -I am usually scrambling to find housing in some way, and it’s really hard with limited options. Options consistently fall through and I end up crashing in a gross room at a house that people from high school (who I don’t talk to or think about ever) live in across town -thinking about it, a lot of my dreams include an open air area almost like a neighborhood. I can access the mall from the neighborhood and do often. But a lot of times, the trip is treacherous, like it’s storming, the vehicles are malfunctioning, or there is a crash All of this to say: do people have multiple malls in the same dream? I have distinct situations that happen in each location, but they often connect to each other. And why is it dangerous to travel between them?
